title: Wayfare Pass Comfort-Rider Upgrade Discount — Questions and Answers
content:
# Comfort-rider upgrade discount — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

**What does the Comfort-rider upgrade discount count?**
On a move up to Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly, the Comfort-rider upgrade discount counts the member's completed Wayfare Comfort and Wayfare Black trips dropped off in the last three months: 5 percent at 3 or more, 2 percent at 1 or 2, nothing at none.

**Which trips qualify for the count?**
Trips in the member's trip records in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares) whose ride option is Wayfare Comfort or Wayfare Black, whose status is completed, and whose drop-off falls in the last three months. A Wayfare Black SUV trip, a cancelled trip, or a trip in any other ride option is not counted.

**How does the discount act?**
It is taken off the Plus Monthly upgrade charge as that percentage of the Plus Monthly membership fee of 19.99. The percentage is of the 19.99 fee itself; the amount taken off is not rounded on its own, and the charge is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**What are the tiers?**

| Completed Comfort and Black trips dropped off in the last three months | Discount |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 5 percent |
| 1 or 2 | 2 percent |
| none | nothing |

Two Comfort trips and one Black trip make 3 and earn 5 percent; two trips earn 2 percent.

**What does that come to?** (hypothetical) 5 percent of 19.99 is 0.9995 taken off the charge; 2 percent is 0.3998.
